newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted at steady to up on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted at steady to up on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels on Thursday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. One barge traded versus one barge trade on Wednesday.
Trades, bids and and offers included:
- One barge, on tow, up mile 125 on Illinois River through Morris, traded at 210 percent of tariff.
- One barge, this week, Spring Valley, Ill., bid 200 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, this week, St Louis, Mississippi River, bid 145 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, Lower Ohio River, bid 140 percent, up five percentage points, similar, offered 160 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of February, St Louis, Mississippi, no bid, offered 115 percent, unchanged.
